title: Forum moderation

flash.approved: Post approved. It is visible now.
flash.rejected: Post rejected. The member sees the reason in their topics.
flash.hidden: Post hidden. The member receives the statement of reasons.
flash.locked: Topic locked. It takes no more replies.
flash.banned: Forum ban imposed. The member receives the statement of reasons.
flash.not_possible: This is no longer possible: the post was changed or decided meanwhile.

conflict.changed: The post was changed meanwhile. Please reload and check again.
conflict.title: Changed meanwhile

intro: Check posts of new accounts before they go live, reports on forum posts and every topic with the team's tools.
view_only: View only: deciding and the tools need a role with “Decide moderation”.
reported_note: You decide reported posts in the case (reports queue), with a statement of reasons for the member. Here you see them in their topic.
keys: Keyboard: j and k switch, a approves, r rejects.

caption.pending: Posts in pre-moderation with waiting time, topic, author and reason
caption.reported: Reported forum posts with priority, reports and case status
caption.threads: Forum topics with category, author, flags, replies and last activity

empty.pending_body: Topics and replies of accounts younger than three days or without a confirmed e-mail wait here for you.
empty.reported_title: No open reports in the forum
empty.reported_body: Member reports and keyword rule hits on forum posts show up here.
empty.threads_body: As soon as members start topics, they are listed here with every tool.
empty.removed_body: Topics whose opening post was removed by a moderation decision are listed here.

decide.thread: New topic by @:username is waiting for approval.
decide.reply: Reply by @:username is waiting for approval.

reject_dialog.body: The post stays invisible to everyone but its author. They see the reason in “My topics”.
reject_dialog.reason_hint: 10 to 1,000 characters, factual and specific. The member reads it.

pane.label: Selected topic
pane.select_pending: Pick a post: its topic opens on the right. j and k switch, a approves, r rejects.
pane.select_thread: Pick a topic: it opens on the right with every post and the tools.
pane.error: The topic could not be loaded
pane.author: Author
pane.merged: Merged: the replies are in the target topic now.
pane.removed_note: Removed by a moderation decision. Restoring it means reversing the decision in the case.

hide.body_thread: The topic disappears for everyone. The member gets the statement of reasons by notification and e-mail and can appeal.
hide.body_reply: The reply disappears for everyone. The member gets the statement of reasons by notification and e-mail and can appeal.

ban.title: Ban @:username from the forum?
ban.description: The member can no longer write or vote in the forum; reading stays possible. They get the statement of reasons by notification and e-mail and can appeal.
ban.current_open: Banned from the forum, no end

tools.label: Tools for the topic
tools.move_body: The topic then sits in the new category; replies and subscriptions stay.
tools.merge_body: Every post moves to the target topic, the opening post as a reply. This topic then points to the target. This cannot be undone.
tools.solution_body: Replaces an earlier solution. The member who replied gets a notification.
tools.solution_clear_body: The topic counts as unsolved again.
tools.target_hint: Published topics of the current list. Filter the list to find another one.
tools.target_paste: Or paste a link or ID
tools.target_paste_hint: An admin link with ?thread=, an app link /forum/… or the ID.
tools.target_required: Pick a target topic or paste its link.
tools.target_invalid: There is no topic ID in this text.

categories.title: Forum categories
categories.intro: The categories members see in the forum, in their order. Make and federal-state categories are created automatically.
categories.view_only: View only: changes need a role with “Moderation rules”.
categories.load_error: The categories could not be loaded
categories.empty_body: Create the first category. Makes and federal states come in through “Sync makes” and the base data.
categories.caption: Forum categories with sub-categories, kind, number of topics and status
categories.generated_note: Automatic categories follow the vehicle catalogue and the federal states; they are read-only here.
categories.reorder_body: This is how the categories appear in the app's forum.
categories.archive_body: Members no longer see the category and cannot start anything new there. Existing topics stay reachable through their link.
categories.restore_body: The category shows up in the forum again, in its previous place.
categories.delete_body: The category is empty and goes for good. If it has topics by now, archive it instead.
categories.sync_body: Creates a category under “Makes & models” for every active make of the vehicle catalogue that is still missing. Existing categories stay as they are.

form.description: Members see name and description in their language.
form.slug_hint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. wheels-tyres. Shows in links to the category.
form.slug_error: Only a–z, 0–9 and single hyphens, at most 80 characters.
form.parent_hint: Sub-categories go one level deep only.
form.parent_locked: This category has sub-categories and therefore stays a main category.
form.icon_hint: Name of a Phosphor icon for the chip in the app, e.g. Wrench.
form.active_hint: Switched off, the category is archived.
